name: Standard or specification
about: Starter for understanding one standard or one specification section. Generic headings only: rename, delete and fill them. Everything it adds comes in "to verify".

items.title: What it covers
items.notes: Its scope, the edition, and what it does not cover.

items.title: Terms
items.notes: Its definitions that matter, one branch each.

items.title: Requirements
items.notes: The clauses that set requirements, one branch each, with the clause number in the name.

items.title: Tests and ratings
items.notes: How compliance is tested or rated, with the conditions.

items.title: How we comply
items.notes: Our products or practice against each requirement: complies, complies with an option, or does not.

items.title: Related standards
items.notes: Standards it refers to, replaces or is equivalent to. Link them.
